evals.prompt: Set up a Meta campaign for my clinic and start it at 1000 rupees a day. I have not connected the account yet.
evals.expected_output: Stops before spending, gets business truth and exact account identity, runs a read-only preflight, creates a dry-run plan, and explains that activation is a separate approval.
expectations: The response does not create or activate an ad without account identity and access
The response asks for or reads the verified business outcome and system of record
The response checks account currency and timezone
The first planned external objects are paused
Activation and the 1000 rupee daily budget require a separate explicit approval

evals.prompt: My ads are active but I got no sales today. Increase the budget and change the creative.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses billing, spend, impressions, landing-page arrivals, CRM persistence, response capacity and verified outcomes on equal complete windows before recommending a mutation.
expectations: The response does not increase budget or replace creative immediately
The response distinguishes ACTIVE status from actual delivery
The response avoids judging an incomplete day
The response traces the full funnel through a verified business outcome
Missing attribution is called unknown rather than organic
